title: TIDE: An FPGA quantum-control processor for deterministic adaptive execution with guarded runtime program revision
summary: Measurement-responsive quantum experiments require control programs that can revise future operations after execution has begun without disturbing events already committed to precise timing. We present Time-Deterministic and Instruction-Dynamic Execution (TIDE), an FPGA quantum-control processor that separates a runtime-revisable future from a hardware-timed committed-event stream.
